DINGGIN ANG HINAING!

Transport group PISTON, together with various multi-sectoral organizations, formed the “No to Oil Price Hike” Coalition as they urged more jeepney drivers to join a two-day transport strike along Aurora Boulevard in Quezon City on Thursday.

The groups called on the national government to scrap the oil deregulation law and remove VAT and excise taxes to help cushion the impact of continued fuel price hikes.

📸 The STAR/ Miguel de Guzman

data.raw_text:
‘WELGA KAMI’

Members of transport group MANIBELA hold placards and chant slogans on the first day of a nationwide jeepney strike at their headquarters in Manila on Thursday.

The group urged the national government to prioritize the removal of excise tax and value-added tax (VAT) on fuel, and to consider repealing the Oil Deregulation Law. It added that around 100,000 transport workers nationwide have joined the ongoing protest.

📸 The STAR/Edd Gumban
